sections.title: The letter o
paragraphs: The letter (о) /o/ is named (о) /o/. Its main sound appears in (окно) /ɐkˈno/, which means window. This letter writes three sounds.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: For the first sound, pull your tongue back and form a round circle with your lips. For the second sound, open your mouth wider and keep your tongue low and central. For the third sound, keep your tongue relaxed in the middle of your mouth. Touch your throat to feel that your voice is on for each sound.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: When stressed, this letter sounds like (дом) /dom/. In the syllable right before the stress, it sounds like (вода) /vɐˈda/. It has this same sound at the start of an unstressed word, as in (окно) /ɐkˈno/. In other unstressed positions, it sounds like the first vowel in (молоко) /məlɐˈko/ or the last in (город) /ˈgorət/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not make a diphthong like the vowel in the English word boat. A diphthong is two vowel sounds that glide together. Keep your lips still from start to finish. Also, do not pronounce every letter as o. Make it shorter and weaker when it has no stress, like the a in about.
